coreMemory.english: v. to make something smaller or less
coreMemory.structure: reduce the risk /rɪˈduːs ðə rɪsk/（降低风险）；reduce costs /rɪˈduːs kɑsts/（降低成本）；reduce stress /rɪˈduːs strɛs/（减轻压力）；reduce by half /rɪˈduːs baɪ hæf/（减少一半）
coreMemory.commonError: ❌ can to reduce → ✅ can reduce；❌ to reduceing → ✅ to reduce

commonErrors.note: 情态动词 can 后直接接动词原形，不加 to。
不定式 to 后接动词原形；不要把不定式和 -ing 形式混合。
